class.name: Chunk
class.brief_description: Individual voxel terrain chunk with mesh and collision management.
class.description:
[b]Chunk[/b] represents a single cubic block of terrain within the voxel world. Chunks are subdivided units of the larger terrain grid, each containing voxel data and optionally rendering/collision geometry.
[b]Architecture:[/b] - Chunks are arranged in a [code]world_size[/code] grid - Each chunk is [code]chunk_size × chunk_size × chunk_size[/code] voxels - Owned by [VoxelGenerator], not directly instantiated by users - Contains voxel data, mesh instance, and collision body
[b]Key Features:[/b] [ul] [li]Stores voxel grid (chunk_size³ voxels)[/li] [li]Manages MeshInstance3D for rendering[/li] [li]Manages StaticBody3D and CollisionShape3D for physics[/li] [li]Thread-safe voxel access via mutex[/li] [li]LOD level tracking for distance-based detail[/li] [li]Mesh readiness state for async generation[/li] [/ul]
[b]Internal Details:[/b] Chunks are managed internally by VoxelGenerator and automatically created, updated, and destroyed as needed. Users typically don't instantiate Chunk directly. However, some advanced use cases may access chunk properties for debugging or optimization.
[b]Related Classes:[/b] [ul] [li][VoxelGenerator] - Creates and manages chunks[/li] [li][Voxel] - Individual voxel within a chunk[/li] [li][BiomeGenerator] - Determines voxel types in chunks[/li] [/ul]
[b]Note:[/b] Chunk is primarily an internal implementation detail. Most game logic should interact with [VoxelGenerator] instead of Chunk directly.

method.name: generate
method.description:
Generates the chunk's voxel data (internal use).
[b]Note:[/b] This is called internally by VoxelGenerator. Not typically called directly.
[b]Thread Safety:[/b] Must be called from main thread.

method.name: set_biome_generator
method.description:
Sets the biome generator for this chunk.
[b]Parameters:[/b] [code]generator[/code] - [BiomeGenerator] instance for voxel determination.
[b]Note:[/b] Automatically called by VoxelGenerator.
[b]See Also:[/b] [method get_biome_generator]

method.name: get_biome_generator
method.description:
Returns the biome generator used by this chunk.
[b]See Also:[/b] [method set_biome_generator]

method.name: set_voxel
method.description:
Sets a voxel type at a local chunk position.
[b]Parameters:[/b] [code]local_pos[/code] - Position relative to chunk origin (0,0,0 to chunk_size-1 for each component) [code]type[/code] - Voxel type ID
[b]Thread Safety:[/b] Safe to call from any thread (internally synchronized via mutex).
[b]Performance:[/b] O(1) operation.
[b]Example:[/b] [code] chunk.set_voxel(Vector3i(4, 4, 4), STONE_VOXEL) [/code]
[b]See Also:[/b] [method get_voxel]

method.name: get_voxel
method.description:
Gets the voxel at a local chunk position.
[b]Parameters:[/b] [code]local_pos[/code] - Position relative to chunk origin.
[b]Return Value:[/b] [Voxel] object with type and material info.
[b]Thread Safety:[/b] Safe to call from any thread.
[b]Example:[/b] [code] var voxel = chunk.get_voxel(Vector3i(4, 4, 4)) print("Voxel type: ", voxel.voxel_type) [/code]
[b]See Also:[/b] [method set_voxel]

method.name: set_chunk_coord
method.description:
Sets the chunk's grid coordinate (debug use).
[b]Parameters:[/b] [code]coord[/code] - 3D grid position (e.g., Vector3i(1, 0, 1) for chunk at grid position 1,0,1).
[b]Note:[/b] Automatically set by VoxelGenerator. Exposed for debugging only.
[b]See Also:[/b] [method get_chunk_coord]

method.name: get_chunk_coord
method.description:
Returns the chunk's grid coordinate.
[b]Return Value:[/b] 3D grid position.
[b]Example:[/b] [code] var coord = chunk.get_chunk_coord() print("Chunk at grid: ", coord) [/code]
[b]See Also:[/b] [method set_chunk_coord]

method.name: apply_mesh_data
method.description:
Applies mesh geometry data to the chunk (main thread only).
[b]Parameters:[/b] [code]vertices[/code] - Array of vertex positions [code]normals[/code] - Array of vertex normals [code]colors[/code] - Array of vertex colors (RGBA) [code]custom0[/code] - Custom per-vertex data (e.g., biome ID)
[b]Effect:[/b] Creates MeshInstance3D with the provided mesh data.
[b]Thread Safety:[/b] Must be called from main thread only.
[b]Note:[/b] Internally called by VoxelGenerator after async mesh generation on worker threads.
[b]See Also:[/b] [method clear_mesh], [method is_mesh_ready]

method.name: set_terrain_material
method.description:
Sets the material applied to the chunk mesh.
[b]Parameters:[/b] [code]material[/code] - [Material] resource (StandardMaterial3D, ShaderMaterial, etc.).
[b]Effect:[/b] Sets the rendering material for this chunk's mesh.
[b]See Also:[/b] [method get_terrain_material]

method.name: get_terrain_material
method.description:
Returns the material applied to this chunk.
[b]See Also:[/b] [method set_terrain_material]

method.name: clear_mesh
method.description:
Removes the mesh instance (unrender the chunk).
[b]Effect:[/b] Deletes MeshInstance3D, making chunk invisible.
[b]Thread Safety:[/b] Must be called from main thread.
[b]See Also:[/b] [method apply_mesh_data], [method is_mesh_ready]

method.name: is_mesh_ready
method.description:
Checks if mesh data has been applied.
[b]Return Value:[/b] true if mesh is ready for rendering, false if still pending.
[b]Thread Safety:[/b] Safe to call from any thread.
[b]Example:[/b] [code] if chunk.is_mesh_ready(): print("Chunk is visible") [/code]
[b]See Also:[/b] [method apply_mesh_data]

method.name: update_collision_shape
method.description:
Updates the collision shape from mesh geometry.
[b]Parameters:[/b] [code]mesh[/code] - ArrayMesh to extract collision from.
[b]Effect:[/b] Creates StaticBody3D with collision shape matching mesh. Enables physics interaction with terrain.
[b]Thread Safety:[/b] Must be called from main thread.
[b]See Also:[/b] [method clear_collision_shape]

method.name: clear_collision_shape
method.description:
Removes the collision shape (disables physics).
[b]Effect:[/b] Deletes StaticBody3D and CollisionShape3D.
[b]Thread Safety:[/b] Must be called from main thread.
[b]See Also:[/b] [method update_collision_shape]

method.name: set_chunk_size
method.description:
Sets the chunk size (voxels per edge) for this chunk.
[b]Parameters:[/b] [code]p_chunk_size[/code] - Size (4, 8, 16, 32, or 64 typical).
[b]Note:[/b] Automatically set by VoxelGenerator. Not typically called manually.
[b]See Also:[/b] [method get_chunk_size], [method get_default_chunk_size]

method.name: get_chunk_size
method.description:
Returns the chunk size (voxels per edge).
[b]Example:[/b] [code] var size = chunk.get_chunk_size() # e.g., 8 var total_voxels = size * size * size # 512 for size 8 [/code]
[b]See Also:[/b] [method set_chunk_size]

method.name: get_default_chunk_size
method.description:
Returns the default chunk size used for new chunks.
[b]Return Value:[/b] Default size (typically 8).
[b]See Also:[/b] [method set_default_chunk_size]

method.name: set_default_chunk_size
method.description:
Sets the default chunk size for all new chunks.
[b]Parameters:[/b] [code]p_chunk_size[/code] - New default size.
[b]Note:[/b] Must be set before generating chunks.
[b]See Also:[/b] [method get_default_chunk_size]

method.name: rebuild_mesh
method.description:
Rebuilds the mesh from current voxel data (internal use).
[b]Note:[/b] Internally called during generation. Advanced use only.
[b]Thread Safety:[/b] Must be called from main thread.

method.name: update_lod
method.description:
Updates LOD level based on distance from camera (debug use).
[b]Parameters:[/b] [code]camera_position[/code] - Camera/player position for distance calculation.
[b]Effect:[/b] Calculates appropriate LOD and marks dirty if changed.
[b]Thread Safety:[/b] Must be called from main thread.
[b]See Also:[/b] [method set_current_lod_level]

method.name: is_voxel_solid
method.description:
Checks if a voxel is solid (non-air).
[b]Parameters:[/b] [code]local_pos[/code] - Local position.
[b]Return Value:[/b] true if voxel type != AIR.
[b]Thread Safety:[/b] Safe to call from any thread.
[b]See Also:[/b] [method get_voxel]

method.name: set_current_lod_level
method.description:
Sets the current LOD level for this chunk (0-7).
[b]Parameters:[/b] [code]lod[/code] - LOD level (0=highest detail, 7=lowest).
[b]Effect:[/b] Used for mesh generation detail. Marks chunk dirty if changed.
[b]See Also:[/b] [method get_current_lod_level]

method.name: get_current_lod_level
method.description:
Returns the current LOD level.
[b]Return Value:[/b] LOD level (0-7).
[b]See Also:[/b] [method set_current_lod_level]
